# SORION

> Independent market intelligence for Sorare football cards: value estimates for more than
> 50,000 cards, floor prices, trends, portfolio tracking and reward thresholds per competition.
> Not affiliated with Sorare.

Updated nightly. Last build: 2026-10-16.

## What the data covers

- Card values (FMV) for Limited, Rare and Super Rare, In-Season and Classic
- Reward thresholds across 21 completed gameweeks of the current season
- Accuracy of every value, measured against real manager to manager sales

## Accuracy, last 7 days

- Limited In-Season: typical miss 18.5 percent, within 20 percent on 52.5 percent of sales
- Limited Classic: typical miss 21.4 percent, within 20 percent on 48.3 percent of sales
- Rare In-Season: typical miss 21.3 percent, within 20 percent on 48 percent of sales
- Rare Classic: typical miss 22.8 percent, within 20 percent on 45.4 percent of sales

## Key pages

- [Market](https://sorion.pro/): searchable table of card values, floors and trends
- [Reward thresholds](https://sorion.pro/thresholds.html): points needed for essence per competition, static text
- [Leaderboards](https://sorion.pro/rewards.html): thresholds and winning squad costs per gameweek
- [Portfolio](https://sorion.pro/portfolio.html): value and profit for any public Sorare manager
- [Accuracy](https://sorion.pro/accuracy.html): how our values compare to real sales
- [Legal and privacy](https://sorion.pro/legal.html)

## How values are produced

Values rest on completed sales between managers. Sorare's own instant buys and auctions are
excluded from the value itself, because vouchers and bundled rewards distort those prices.
Accuracy is published, not claimed: every estimate is compared against the sales that follow it.

## Attribution

Quoting these numbers is fine with a link to https://sorion.pro. Bulk scraping or redistribution is not.
